load_customized_adapter: load a custom adapter module from a diffusers component path using safetensors weights
resolve_model_cls_adapter: resolve the model class from a diffusers _class_name using the ModelRegistry
list_safetensors_files: list all safetensors files in a component model directory
load_safetensors_state_dict: load a safetensors state dict file into a PyTorch model with strict=False
build_connector_from_config: build an LTX-2 connector module from a diffusers config.json and safetensors weights
